findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler is abstract and cannot be instantiated
findings.body: `StatefulDetectorHandler` now has abstract methods: `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values`, `build_occurrence_and_event_data`, and probably `counter_names`. This subclass is just `pass`, so it implements none of them. `Detector.detector_handler` instantiates the handler, so any metric alert detector now raises `TypeError` in `process_detectors`. Before this change the handler was concrete and returned `[]`. Either implement the abstract methods or keep the previous stub handler, updated to return `{}`.
